hook_text: Phone away for a week. Then this.

song.title: Focus Mode
song.style: English, warm indie folk with banjo, plucked strings and brushed drums building to a stomping finish, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, 100 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Tapped the eye, the room went still
Found some yarn up on the shelf
Click clack click through Monday night
Tuesday I surprised myself

[Chorus]
Longer, longer, out the door
Down the street and round the shore
Tapped the eye and look at that
Scarves for everyone and the cat

shots.prompt: {moss} sits buried in a giant mountain of colourful striped knitted scarf, only his beanie and glasses poking out, grinning. Static wide shot. Warm afternoon light.

A finger gently taps the round pale yellow disc on a small rounded moss-green brick stuck to a white fridge door, a black smartphone standing upright inside it facing the wall. Warm light slowly shifts across the fridge. Static close-up.
{moss} pulls a basket of yarn and knitting needles down from a shelf, eyes lighting up. Static medium shot. Soft daylight.
{moss} knits fast in an armchair at night by lamplight, needles flying. The camera pushes in. Warm lamp light.
{moss} stares in surprise as the striped scarf spills off his lap across the floor and out the open door. Static wide shot. Morning light.
{moss} walks down a street unrolling an endless striped scarf behind him as neighbours point and laugh. The camera tracks backward. Bright sunny light.
{moss} wraps a length of scarf around a neighbour's neck, then around a happy dog. Static medium shot. Warm sunlight.
{moss} wraps a tiny bit of scarf around a cat, who looks very pleased. Static close-up. Warm afternoon light.
{moss} sits on a hill with his neighbours, all wrapped together in one long striped scarf, watching the sunset. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach and gold, calm.

caption: Moss tapped the eye on his Hibernator, found some yarn, and now the whole street has scarves. The cat too.
